title: The composition isomorphism of pushforwards is monoidal
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a closed braided monoidal Grothendieck abelian category (for instance $\mathcal A=\Ab$), and let $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms of schemes. Work with the small pro-étale sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], with universes large enough for $\mathcal A$-valued sheaves. Use the pushforwards of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star], and on each sheaf category the sheafification of the pointwise tensor, with unit the sheafified constant presheaf at $\mathbf1_{\mathcal A}$ [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators]. Give each pushforward $h_*$, $h\in\{f,g,g\circ f\}$, its canonical lax monoidal structure induced from restriction of presheaves and sheafification: for $h\colon S\to T$ and sheaves $F,G$ on $S_{\mathrm{proét}}$, the tensor comparison $h_*F\otimes h_*G\to h_*(F\otimes G)$ and the unit comparison $\mathbf1_T\to h_*\mathbf1_S$ are the unique morphisms of sheaves whose composites with the sheafification maps $(V\mapsto F(V\times_TS)\otimes G(V\times_TS))\to h_*F\otimes h_*G$ and $\underline{\mathbf1}\to\mathbf1_T$ are, at each $V$, the components at $V\times_TS$ of the sheafification maps $(W\mapsto F(W)\otimes G(W))\to F\otimes G$ and $\underline{\mathbf1}\to\mathbf1_S$. For symmetric coefficients these are the structure maps of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-lax-monoidal]. The composition isomorphism $c:g_*\circ f_*\xrightarrow{\sim}(g\circ f)_*$ of [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp], induced by $(V\times_ZY)\times_YX\cong V\times_ZX$, is monoidal for the composite lax monoidal structure on $g_*\circ f_*$ and the canonical lax monoidal structure on $(g\circ f)_*$. For symmetric coefficients this tensor is the one of [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor].

proof.text:
Use [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators] on the three small sites of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], in one sufficiently large universe. Write $t_T,u_T$ for its natural tensor and unit generators. By [lem-sfb-sheaf-pushforward-generator-comparison], restriction followed by sheafification has the canonical comparisons characterized by
$$\mu_h(V)t_T(h_*F,h_*G)_V=t_S(F,G)_{V\times_TS},\qquad e_h(V)(u_T)_V=(u_S)_{V\times_TS}.$$
These are the maps prescribed in the statement; their uniqueness is the cited Hom bijection. This applies to $h=f,g,k=g\circ f$ since [def-sfb-finite-lower-star] identifies each pushforward with continuous restriction.

proof.text:
For $V\in Z_{\mathrm{proét}}$ put $W=(V\times_ZY)\times_YX$, $W'=V\times_ZX$. By [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp], $c_F(V)=F(b)$ for the canonical isomorphism $b:W'\to W$. Precompose
$$c_{F\otimes G}\circ g_*(\mu_f)\circ\mu_g=\mu_k\circ(c_F\otimes c_G)$$
with $t_Z(g_*f_*F,g_*f_*G)$. Twice the formulas of step 1 turn its left side at $V$ into $(F\otimes G)(b)\circ t_X(F,G)_W$. Naturality in $F,G$ of $t_Z$, then step 1 for $k$, turns its right side into $t_X(F,G)_{W'}\circ(F(b)\otimes G(b))$. Presheaf naturality of $t_X$ equates these expressions. The tensor equality test of [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators] gives the tensor axiom.

source.place: Proof, third sentence: tensor compatibility along the actual pasting isomorphism

proof.text: Precompose the unit equation $c_{\mathbf1_X}\circ g_*(e_f)\circ e_g=e_k$ with $u_Z$. Step 1 gives respectively $\mathbf1_X(b)\circ(u_X)_W$ and $(u_X)_{W'}$. They agree by naturality of $u_X$, since the constant presheaf sends $b$ to the identity. The unit equality test of [lem-sfb-braided-sheaf-tensor-generators] proves the equation. These tensor and unit equations define a monoidal transformation. Since [def-sfb-finite-lower-star-comp] already gives a natural isomorphism, $c$ is a monoidal natural isomorphism.

lean.statement:
instance ProEtale.isMonoidal_lowerStarComp :
    NatTrans.IsMonoidal (ProEtale.lowerStarComp A f g).hom
lean.note: Exact pro-etale specialization of the previously attached general continuous-site instance. The published source, read through scompile.py --source, binds A : Type u' with Category.{u + 1}, Abelian, IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1}, MonoidalCategory, BraidedCategory and MonoidalClosed, and arbitrary f : X ⟶ Y and g : Y ⟶ Z with X Y Z : Scheme.{u}. Its conclusion uses the canonical lowerStarComp induced by pullbackComp, with the existing composite lax monoidal structure. No additional hypotheses or replacement maps. The current published body applies the general monoidality instance and has no sorry.
